Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

anumaan 0.1.0.9045

  • daly_fit_los_rr() has been rewritten. It now returns a list (rr, hospital, draws, skipped) instead of a data frame.
    • Hospitals enter as a fixed effect in one model per pathogen x class (hospital_effect = "fixed", the new default), so the relative LOS is shared and every hospital keeps its own LOS level. "none" and "stratified" (one model per hospital, the previous behaviour) remain available. RxHospital_p tests whether the resistance effect differs between hospitals.
    • The unit is the admission (admission_id_col; patient_id_col is deprecated). Resistance is the worst phenotype of the pathogen’s own results in the admission, and covariates come from its earliest culture of that pathogen. Polymicrobial admissions now enter every pathogen’s models.
    • Returns adjusted LOSR and LOSS (model predictions averaged over each hospital’s resistant admissions with R = 1 and R = 0) and their difference, per hospital and overall, instead of raw means only.
    • Confidence intervals for RR_LOS, LOSR, LOSS and the excess from a bootstrap that resamples clusters (cluster_id_col, e.g. patients) within hospitals (ci_method = "bootstrap"), or from the delta method with a cluster-robust covariance ("delta"). return_draws = TRUE returns the bootstrap replicates.
    • New arguments classes (a panel per pathogen), reference_hospital, intermediate_as_resistant, hai_value, cai_value, icu_values, flag_min. hai_threshold_hours is deprecated.
  • daly_assign_rr_to_profiles() accepts profiles as R/S strings (e.g. the profile_delta / R_mean output of profile_aggregate_for_daly()) with profile_class_order giving the class of each letter, and accepts the daly_fit_los_rr() list directly. Each profile then takes the adjusted LOS of its dominant class at its own hospital. Ties in the max rule go to the first class in class order and are reported.
  • daly_calc_yld_associated() and daly_calc_yld_attributable() match each hospital to its own profiles and LOS when profiles are hospital-specific, and return percentile intervals when given los_draws (bootstrap draws from daly_fit_los_rr()) and optionally profile_draws (profile posterior draws).
  • daly_fit_mortality_rr() now builds class resistance from each pathogen’s own results. Previously one pathogen’s results could set another pathogen’s resistance in the same patient, and patients with several pathogens entered only one pathogen’s models.

anumaan 0.1.0.9044

  • prep_standardize_antibiotics() now keeps combination antibiotics intact. Names such as “piperacillin-tazobactam” and “trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole” were reduced to one component and given that component’s class (“Penicillins”, “Sulfonamides”). They now match their WHO combination rows (“Beta-lactam/beta-lactamase-inhibitor_anti-pseudomonal”, “Sulfonamide-trimethoprim-combinations”), and reserve combinations such as ceftazidime-avibactam keep their AWaRe category. Matching treats -, +, /, & and “and” as one separator, ignores word order and tolerates one-letter misspellings in long names.
  • A combination with no reference row keeps its full name, is left unclassified and is reported in a warning instead of being reduced to one component.
  • Added inst/extdata/antibiotic_combination_supplement.csv for combinations absent from WHO_aware_class.csv (cefoperazone-sulbactam, ticarcillin-clavulanic acid). It is appended to the default reference.

anumaan 0.1.0.9042

  • Added the joint Bernoulli resistance-profile pipeline (profile_*), a log-linear model over all 2^D resistance states that marginalises untested antibiotic classes exactly. It covers cohort selection and support audits (profile_select_cohort(), profile_audit_support(), profile_plan_precision(), profile_define_cohort()), model design and fitting (profile_build_design(), profile_fit_joint_bernoulli()), diagnostics (profile_check_sampler(), profile_ppc(), profile_prior_predictive()), validation (profile_validate_masked(), profile_validate_heldout(), profile_validate_newpatient(), profile_validate_temporal()), estimation (profile_estimate()), aggregation (profile_aggregate_for_daly()) and reporting (profile_release(), profile_render_report()).
  • Added profile_audit_profile_distribution() for per-profile prevalence auditing and profile_aggregate_counts_with_allocation() for discrete count aggregation.
  • Patient holdout validation now supports stratified sampling and scores complete joint profiles. Sampling is fixed for single numeric patient IDs, singleton strata stay in training, and stratum holdout is capped.
  • Masked validation no longer leaves an event with no observed classes, and average precision no longer depends on the order of tied scores.
  • Estimation and masked-cell prediction share one compatible-state softmax, which prevents underflow in conditional profile probabilities.
  • Validation refits now receive the original model specification through design_spec; unknown design_spec fields are an error.
  • The burden eligibility flags from profile_aggregate_for_daly() are renamed computational_checks_passed_YLL and computational_checks_passed_YLD, so they are not read as a release decision.
  • prep_deduplicate_ast() is generalised, and the profile_* functions delegate their AST conflict policy to it.
  • Length of stay now has a single definition. Distribution-based LOS uses medians, and daly_fit_los_distn_by_profile() fits LOS at profile level. prepare_los_data() is removed.
  • Removed unused multivariate-probit utilities: plot_probit_diagnostics(), plot_probit_posterior_predictive_checks(), compute_probit_ppc_statistics(), compute_posterior_predictive_status(), compute_prior_predictive_status(), compute_prior_predictive_fingerprint() and the simulate_probit_*_predictive() functions.
  • compute_hospital_daly() moved from the plotting file to the YLL file; its behaviour is unchanged.

anumaan 0.1.0.9036

  • Prepared for CRAN submission: every exported example now runs, internal helpers no longer produce Rd pages, and console tables printed during preprocessing are emitted with message() so suppressMessages() silences them.
  • Pathway 1 now works with osqp >= 1.0. osqp 1.0 removed the $solve() method, so every osqp solve errored and estimate_profiles_convex(), compute_resistance_profiles() and bootstrap_profiles_convex() silently returned uniform profile probabilities flagged as non-converged. They now call osqp::solve_osqp(), which works across osqp versions.
  • compute_marginals_from_data() and compute_pairwise_from_data() no longer drop antibiotic classes whose names contain hyphens, slashes or spaces (e.g. “Third-generation-cephalosporins”), which preprocess_for_profiles() had renamed when pivoting to wide format.
  • Organism, drug and syndrome names are now compared case-insensitively through one lower-case key. As a result org_group and rr_pathogen are populated for run_preprocess() output (previously “Other” and NA for every row), and panel_map, syndrome_name and pathogen_name arguments match regardless of case; outputs keep the data’s own labels. The derived keys rr_pathogen and the pathogen column of daly_load_rr_reference() are now lower case.
  • Fixed inst/extdata/adjustment_for_CFR.csv: an unquoted comma in “Infections of bones, joints, and related organs” corrupted that row.
  • Functions that take a seed argument now restore the caller’s random number generator state on exit.
  • preprocess_for_profiles() no longer errors at the deduplication step; it now deduplicates isolate x drug rows before collapsing to antibiotic class level.
  • daly_calc_yll_associated() and daly_load_rr_reference() now read the bundled CSV reference tables (the .xlsx files they expected are no longer shipped).

anumaan 0.1.0.9021

  • Expanded the specimen classification reference with stewardship sample labels seen in 2021-era extracts, including brain abscess, instrument, lung aspirate, lymph node, hair, and superficial biopsy.
  • Collapsed sterile_classification outputs from detailed reference labels to Sterile, Non-Sterile, and Others/Ambiguous for downstream analysis.
  • Made EDA and burden plotting functions usable without ggpubr; when ggpubr is not installed, eda_theme() falls back to ggplot2::theme_bw().
  • Refreshed vignettes and installation guidance for the 0.1.0.9021 workflow.
